# Post Review Rubric

Score each dimension from 1 to 5. A final post needs at least 4 in every dimension and no blocking issue.

| Dimension | A score of 5 means |
| --- | --- |
| Authenticity | It sounds like a real practitioner and makes no invented claim. |
| Specificity | The situation, action, and lesson contain useful concrete detail. |
| Clarity | One main idea is immediately understandable. |
| Credibility | Claims are firsthand, qualified, or backed by a current source. |
| Audience fit | The value and vocabulary suit the selected audience. |
| Opening strength | The first lines create relevant curiosity without clickbait. |
| Skimmability | Short paragraphs and restrained formatting work on mobile. |
| Conversation value | The close invites a focused professional discussion. |

## Blocking Issues

- Confidential or identifying information without confirmed permission.
- Invented or materially altered experience details.
- Unsupported current, statistical, causal, or trending claims.
- Approval applies to a different version of the text.
- Promotional, discriminatory, misleading, or engagement-manipulating language.
- More than five hashtags or hashtags unrelated to the post.

## Optimizer Output

Return:

1. Scores and concise reasons.
2. Blocking issues, if any.
3. Final post when there are no blockers.
4. One alternate hook.
5. A factual change log confirming that no facts were added.
6. Suggested image alt text when an image is included.
